entries.value: measured EIA Henry Hub daily spot (data/raw/gas-prices/henry_hub_daily.csv), resampled onto calendar days and renormalized to mean exactly 1.0 per month (G-A1 fix 9037c89) so the monthly delivered level is byte-kept and only the intra-month swing rides on top; the same mean-preserving factors are re-carried onto every F923-overwritten gas plant-month. Zero tunable values; forecast-native (a forward monthly level times a representative daily shape). Bound: HH-ONLY — the eastern-hub daily-basis blowout beyond the HH move is not carried (chartered follow-on intake).

entries.name: campd-unit-outages-short-PJM.csv (unit_outage_short_windows)
entries.source: short (1-5 day) baseload-coal full-unit stops detected on each unit's own CAMPD gross by the frozen deriver (scripts/derive_campd_unit_outages.py --short-windows --iso PJM): coal-only detector + the WHEN-OPERABLE baseload guard (CF >= 0.55 over hours outside the unit's own >= 5-day standard windows) + the revealed-availability in-merit filter. ZERO tunable values: the 0.55 guard, the coal-only detector, the 1-5-day cap and the in-merit filter are all UNCHANGED; the only deriver change is the guard's identification BASIS (raw-annual -> when-operable), cited to the measurement in docs/DIAGNOSIS-pjm-c3c-summer-tail-2026-07.md §7 (event-unit when-operable CF 0.58-0.72 vs raw-annual 0.09-0.36), NOT to any price residual.
entries.note: Physical availability event (rule 13); forecast-native analogue is the statistical WEFOR/POF draw; backcast-mode calibration input only. Re-derives ONLY on a CAMPD vintage change (rule 23), never on a residual. New-ISO intake of an existing datatype.
